name: closed_loop_strawberry_hydration_and_recalibrated_growth_graph
description: Removes the paralyzing 800-cash Day 0-2 reserve lock while strictly protecting midnight payroll, installs a closed-loop strawberry hydration and zero-waste harvesting engine, and optimizes shop fulfillment and endgame liquidation.

execution_contract.traversal: Evaluate edges in ascending priority. State audit selects exactly one validation branch. On the valid-state path, visit planning nodes sequentially; specialized liquidation/scalping nodes feed directly into action_scheduler. Only action_scheduler submits engine orders.
execution_contract.planning_semantics: Nodes propose individual legal actions with prerequisites, quantity, estimated cash effect, capacity effect, deadline, and purpose. Proposals are evaluated cumulatively against remaining cash and order limits.
execution_contract.unknown_values: Null is unknown, never zero or false. Derive missing fields only from authoritative observations and documented engine timing.
execution_contract.submission_semantics: Count all trades, purchases, movements, refills, deposits, and worker commands against the engine's actual order rules. Do not assume multi-step operations execute in a single command.
execution_contract.dependency_semantics: Use same-tick dependencies only when engine execution order is documented and guaranteed; otherwise wait for acknowledgment and re-observation.
execution_contract.feedback: Re-audit after each engine response. Never infer successful sales, hiring, deposits, or watering from submission alone.

derived_state.midnight_payroll_due: hands_count * 120 + 100, reconciled against authoritative payroll field
derived_state.available_cash: observed cash minus existing committed debits in current batch; excludes speculative sale proceeds
derived_state.emergency_lock: (hour >= 18 and payroll_shortfall > 0) or (day == 0 and hour >= 18 and available_cash < midnight_payroll_due)
derived_state.terminal_active: step >= 696 and step < 720, unless authoritative match timing specifies a different final window
derived_state.phase_hand_cap: 3 for day <= 2; 6 for 3 <= day <= 6; 9 for 7 <= day <= 12; no hiring thereafter
derived_state.phase_plot_cap: 8 for day <= 2; 16 for 3 <= day <= 6; 26 for 7 <= day <= 12; no purchases thereafter
derived_state.remaining_orders: 10 minus the number of validated orders already selected for this tick
derived_state.projected_shed_use: observed shed use plus feasible scheduled deposits minus acknowledged removals or guaranteed earlier same-tick removals
derived_state.can_refill_needed: worker watering can charges == 0 or (worker watering can charges < 2 and worker is adjacent to well)

nodes.name: Authoritative State and Telemetry Audit
nodes.description: Validate time, cash, worker count, worker positions, packs, watering-can charges, plot soil moisture levels, crop maturity stages, shed capacity, and action limits. Reconcile prior orders. Record missing required fields explicitly rather than hallucinating state.

nodes.name: Observation Recovery and Safe Hold
nodes.description: Request or re-read authoritative state through supported observation mechanisms. Suspend unsupported trades, hiring, planting, and expansion during telemetry blackout; execute only verified safe hold actions.

nodes.name: Deadline-Aware Terminal Planner
nodes.description: During the terminal window (steps >= 696), release shop and input reserves, halt expansion, and propose feasible inventory sales plus harvest-travel-deposit chains that settle before step 720.

nodes.name: Actual-Liability Payroll Defense
nodes.description: Enforce absolute payroll solvency. Always maintain cash >= midnight_payroll_due (hands * 120 + 100). On any day at hour >= 18 with payroll_shortfall > 0, lock discretionary spending and propose minimal executable liquidation needed to close the gap.

nodes.name: Deposit-Aware Capacity Planner
nodes.description: Maintain capacity for incoming worker deposits. Initiate relief when projected utilization exceeds 88%, selling vulnerable surplus commodities or low-opportunity excess inputs before workers deposit.

nodes.name: Demand-Aware Premium Deliveries
nodes.description: Deliver eligible inventory to unlocked town shops paying 2.0x-3.5x premiums. Maintain 12-16 reserved units per commodity for recurring shop orders, but release to meet intended shop deliveries or resolve hard payroll shortfalls.

nodes.name: Wool and Milk Glut Front-Run
nodes.description: When forecasts predict an imminent opponent supply glut, liquidate held Wool and Milk 4-8 steps ahead before prices collapse. Prefer shop sales if available; otherwise execute market orders.

nodes.name: Post-Cost Affordable Phased Growth
nodes.description: During Days 0-12 before hour 18, propose hiring, land, and strawberry seeds as an atomic bundle where cash remaining after all proposed purchases exceeds midnight_payroll_due + 60. Obey phase hand/plot caps; halt all hiring, land, and strawberry seed buying on Day 13.

nodes.name: Closed-Loop Strawberry Hydration and Zero-Waste Harvest Planner
nodes.description: Execute deterministic closed-loop worker routing: 1) Refill watering can at well if empty or adjacent with < 2 charges; 2) Water strawberry plots before moisture decays below threshold to maximize recurring yield; 3) Harvest mature strawberries immediately to trigger next regrowth cycle; 4) Deposit harvested berries when pack >= 80% or shed headroom permits.

nodes.name: Keiz Opening Wheat Scalp
nodes.description: On step 0, buy exactly 1 unit of WHEAT. On step 1, sell exactly 1 unit of WHEAT to capture opening spread.

nodes.name: Tiered Shed Pressure Valve
nodes.description: When shed utilization exceeds 90% (and aggressively at 95%), relax price floors down to 0.15 or 0.05 of base price to immediately evacuate bulky inventory and prevent worker deposit chokes.

nodes.name: Fertilizer Monetization
nodes.description: When holding 3+ units of FERTILIZER and price is >= 45% of base, sell excess units in small batches, retaining 1 unit for crop fertilization.

nodes.name: Predictive Early-Endgame Liquidation
nodes.description: During steps 680 to 711, preemptively liquidate high-value assets (MELON, TOMATO, FERTILIZER, WOOL) forecast to suffer terminal opponent dumping while market prices remain high.

nodes.name: Final Turn Forced Liquidation
nodes.description: At steps 718 and 719, submit 100% full liquidation sell orders for all items in the shed regardless of price floors to maximize final settlement cash.

nodes.name: Shared Ten-Order Scheduler and Legality Gate
nodes.description: Merge all candidate proposals from sequential planners and specialized modules into one strictly valid batch of at most 10 orders. Prioritize terminal liquidation, payroll solvency, hydration/harvest cycles, shop premiums, and affordable growth without duplicate worker assignments or overselling.

nodes.name: Acknowledgment and Decision Trace
nodes.description: Record submitted orders, engine execution responses, updated cash balances, and worker states. Reconcile rejections before the next planning cycle.

attributes.guidance: Suspend execution and request authoritative state. Do not fabricate game state or assume zero payroll liability.
attributes.pitfalls: Coercing null values to zero; issuing blind growth orders during observation gaps.

attributes.guidance: Log recovery state and yield tick safely.
attributes.pitfalls: Submitting unverified production orders while state is invalid.

attributes.guidance: Begin planning pipeline. Activate terminal liquidation only if terminal_active is true.
attributes.pitfalls: Executing terminal dump before terminal window begins.

attributes.guidance: Enforce payroll defense. Ensure cash remains >= midnight_payroll_due. On Days 1+, lock spending at hour >= 18 if available cash < midnight payroll.
attributes.pitfalls: Allowing cash to drop below midnight payroll; assuming unharvested crops can be sold on Day 0.

attributes.guidance: Calculate available shed capacity accounting for proposed payroll sales and scheduled deposits.
attributes.pitfalls: Double-counting shed relief sales or allowing pack overflow.

attributes.guidance: Propose deliveries for premium shop orders, preserving 12-16 units for recurring shop demand.
attributes.pitfalls: Refusing shop deliveries to preserve buffers intended for that shop.

attributes.guidance: Sell vulnerable Wool/Milk ahead of predicted market gluts.
attributes.pitfalls: Holding inventory into a forecasted price collapse.

attributes.guidance: Propose growth only if day < 13, hour < 18, emergency_lock is false, and total post-purchase cash >= midnight_payroll_due + 60. Treat hiring, land, and seeds as an aggregate atomic spend.
attributes.pitfalls: Hoarding cash with excessive Day 0-2 buffers (+800) that halt strawberry planting; spending below midnight payroll liability.

attributes.guidance: Schedule worker assignments using closed-loop priority: refill empty cans at well -> water drying strawberry beds -> harvest ripe crops -> deposit to shed.
attributes.pitfalls: Sending workers to water crops with an empty watering can; failing to harvest ripe strawberries immediately.

attributes.guidance: Pass sequential proposals into the unified 10-order scheduler.
attributes.pitfalls: Exceeding 10 total orders or assigning multiple actions to one worker.

attributes.guidance: Prioritize step 0 buy and step 1 sell of WHEAT.
Submit high-priority shed clearance orders with relaxed price floors.
attributes.pitfalls: Allowing shed to reach 100% capacity and stall worker harvesting.

attributes.guidance: Monetize surplus fertilizer when price >= 0.45 base.
attributes.pitfalls: Selling the last fertilizer unit needed for active crops.

attributes.guidance: Propose preemptive liquidation of high-value goods before opponent endgame dumps.
attributes.pitfalls: Holding shop reserves through the endgame collapse.

attributes.guidance: Submit unconditional 100% sell orders for all remaining shed inventory.
attributes.pitfalls: Leaving unsold inventory in shed at step 720.

attributes.guidance: Submit validated batch of at most 10 orders; capture engine response and update execution telemetry.
attributes.pitfalls: Submitting more than 10 orders; ignoring rejected order feedback.

attributes.guidance: Advance to next tick and re-audit authoritative state.
attributes.pitfalls: Preserving stale proposals across game ticks.
